item.title: Abbott Responds To Shooting
item.description: Governor Greg Abbott is responding after a deadly shooting outside a bar in Austin, Texas. In a statement released Sunday, Abbott said he mourns with the families and loved ones affected, and has “offered the full support of the State of Texas to ensure all assistance and resources are deployed.” He also said the act of violence will not define us, nor will it shake the resolve of Texans.

item.title: UT Says Students Impacted In Shooting
item.description: University of Texas President Jim Davis says UT students are among those impacted in a shooting outside a bar in Austin early Sunday morning. The shooting left three people dead, including the gunman and also injured 14 others. FBI Acting Special Agent in Charge Alex Doran says they are investigating the shooting as a possible case of terrorism. The status of the possible students impacted is unclear.

item.title: Abbott Throwing Support Behind Trump
item.description: Governor Greg Abbott is throwing his support behind President Trump amid the joint U.S.-Israeli combat operation against Iran. In a post on X, Abbott said Trump’s message to Iran is clear: aggression toward America and our allies will no longer be tolerated. He also wrote that he’s directed the Texas Department of Public Safety and Texas National Guard to intensify patrols and surveillance.

item.title: Fort Worth Shooting
item.description: One person is dead and two others were injured after a shooting in Fort Worth early Sunday morning. Police say officers were called to the 1200 block of NW 35th Street for reports of a shooting and found a victim with an apparent gunshot wound. They were pronounced dead at the scene. Police later learned that two other victims were located at local area hospitals. The details surrounding the shooting are under investigation.

item.title: Former Shah’s Son Thanks Trump, Outlines Plan For Iran’s Future
item.description: Prince Reza Pahlavi, the exiled son of Iran’s last shah, wrote a commentary in Sunday’s Washington Post thanking President Trump and outlining a political transition plan for Iran. The essay provided a detailed roadmap for an orderly democratic transition after the fall of the Islamic Republic.
